steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure salt, spices, oil; get a pan ready.

steps.label: Quick brine
steps.detail: Submerge the breasts in salted water 15 min, then pat very dry.

steps.label: Pound even
steps.detail: Pound the thick end so each breast is an even thickness.

steps.label: Season & sear
steps.detail: Rub with oil and spices; sear 3-4 min until golden.

steps.label: Flip & steam
steps.detail: Flip, cover, low heat 6-8 min to 74C.

steps.label: Rest & slice
steps.detail: Rest 5 min, slice against the grain, finish with lemon.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat shrimp dry, slice garlic, wash greens.

steps.label: Bloom garlic
steps.detail: Warm oil, garlic, and chili until fragrant, 1 min.

steps.label: Wilt greens
steps.detail: Add greens with a pinch of salt; toss until just wilted.

steps.label: Sear shrimp
steps.detail: Add shrimp in one layer; 1-2 min per side until opaque.

steps.label: Lemon & toss
steps.detail: Squeeze lemon, toss together, taste for salt.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice pepper, slice mushrooms, measure whites.

steps.label: Soften veg
steps.detail: Saute pepper and mushroom 3-4 min; wilt in spinach.

steps.label: Add whites
steps.detail: Lower heat, pour in seasoned whites, let set 20 sec.

steps.label: Fold gently
steps.detail: Push edges to center in big folds until just set.

steps.label: Plate
steps.detail: Pull while glossy; season and serve.

steps.label: Preheat oven 220C
steps.detail: Get the oven fully hot before the tomatoes go in.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat cod dry and season; halve tomatoes, smash garlic.

steps.label: Roast tomatoes
steps.detail: Toss tomatoes, garlic, oil, chili; roast 12 min until bursting.

steps.label: Nestle the cod
steps.detail: Season fillets, nestle into the tomatoes, spoon juices over.

steps.label: Bake the fish
steps.detail: Roast 10-12 min until the cod flakes at 60C.

steps.label: Lemon & herbs
steps.detail: Squeeze lemon, scatter herbs, serve with pan juices.

steps.label: Preheat oven 200C
steps.detail: Heat oven and line a tray (a rack helps).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Finely chop spinach, mince garlic, measure seasoning.

steps.label: Mix the meat
steps.detail: Combine turkey, egg, spinach, garlic, oats, seasoning; don't overwork.

steps.label: Roll balls
steps.detail: Form ~16 even balls with damp hands.

steps.label: Bake
steps.detail: Bake 18-20 min until 74C and golden.

steps.label: Rest & serve
steps.detail: Rest 2 min; serve with marinara, greens, or grains.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Drain tuna, rinse beans, dice onion, chop parsley.

steps.label: Whisk dressing
steps.detail: Whisk lemon, oil, salt, pepper in a bowl.

steps.label: Mellow onion
steps.detail: Stir diced onion into the dressing; let it mellow 5 min.

steps.label: Fold it together
steps.detail: Fold in beans, flaked tuna, and parsley.

steps.label: Taste & serve
steps.detail: Adjust lemon and salt; eat as-is or over greens.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Rinse quinoa, cube chicken, gather toppings.

steps.label: Simmer quinoa
steps.detail: Simmer quinoa in water, covered, ~15 min; rest off heat.

steps.label: Sear chicken
steps.detail: Toss chicken with cumin and salt; sear 6-8 min to 74C.

steps.label: Prep the veg
steps.detail: Dice cucumber and halve tomatoes while things cook.

steps.label: Whisk tahini sauce
steps.detail: Stir tahini, lemon, and water into a drizzle.

steps.label: Build the bowls
steps.detail: Bowl quinoa, greens, veg, and chicken; drizzle sauce.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Press and cube tofu, grate ginger, prep veg.

steps.label: Mix the sauce
steps.detail: Stir tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, and cornstarch slurry.

steps.label: Crisp the tofu
steps.detail: Sear cubed tofu until golden on most sides; remove.

steps.label: Stir-fry veg
steps.detail: Toss veg and edamame over high heat 3-4 min.

steps.label: Add aromatics & sauce
steps.detail: Ginger and garlic 30 sec, then the sauce to thicken.

steps.label: Toss & serve
steps.detail: Return tofu; toss until glossy and coated.

steps.label: Preheat oven 220C
steps.detail: Get the oven fully hot.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Season chicken, trim asparagus, smash garlic, slice lemon.

steps.label: Roast chicken
steps.detail: Tray the chicken with oil, garlic, paprika; roast 15 min.

steps.label: Add asparagus
steps.detail: Add spears and lemon slices to the tray.

steps.label: Roast asparagus
steps.detail: Roast 8-10 min more until chicken is 74C and spears tender-crisp.

steps.label: Squeeze & serve
steps.detail: Squeeze the roasted lemon over everything and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Julienne ginger, slice scallions, set up the steamer plate.

steps.label: Heat the steamer
steps.detail: Bring 2cm water to a simmer with a rack or plate.

steps.label: Steam the fish
steps.detail: Steam fish with half the ginger 7-9 min until it flakes.

steps.label: Warm the sauce
steps.detail: Warm tamari with sugar and a splash of steaming water; pour over.

steps.label: Sizzle aromatics
steps.detail: Top with scallion and ginger; pour over smoking-hot oil.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Finish with cilantro and white pepper.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion, mince garlic, separate lettuce, ready toppings.

steps.label: Soften aromatics
steps.detail: Cook onion 3 min; add garlic and spices 30 sec.

steps.label: Brown the turkey
steps.detail: Add turkey; break up and cook until no longer pink.

steps.label: Saucy finish
steps.detail: Add a splash of water and salt; simmer 3-4 min until glossy.

steps.label: Build the cups
steps.detail: Spoon into lettuce cups; top with lime, cilantro, salsa.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice cucumber and halve the tomatoes.

steps.label: Season the base
steps.detail: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl; season with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Add toppings
steps.detail: Pile on cucumber and tomato.

steps.label: Drizzle & serve
steps.detail: Drizzle oil and lemon; scatter herbs and chili flakes.
